title: Leamas Closure Plan v1
description: Closure Protocol v1 plan wire schema. Authoritative description of accepted JSON shape; runtime and strict Go decoder MUST agree. See ACT-LEAMAS-FACTORY-CLOSURE-PROTOCOL-V1-PLAN-EXECUTION-MODE-RECONCILIATION01.

contract_version.description: Integer discriminator that identifies the v1 wire format. The current implementation accepts only the value 1.

act_id.description: Repository-scoped identifier of the Action Closure Tracker this plan belongs to.

baseline.description: Git identity that anchors the closure window.

commit_oid.description: Full lowercase SHA-1 or SHA-256 Git OID identifying the baseline commit.

tree_oid.description: Full lowercase Git OID identifying the baseline tree.

execution.description: Execution policy descriptor. The mode field is required and must be the literal string 'serial_fail_fast'.

mode.description: The execution mode the runtime should adopt. Closure Protocol v1 supports exactly one value: 'serial_fail_fast'.

checks.description: Ordered list of checks the runner must execute. At least one check is required.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the check.

mode.description: Whether the check is run or excluded from this closure plan.

argv.description: Command arguments. Required when mode='run'; absent when mode='exclude'.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-check timeout in seconds. Required when mode='run'; absent when mode='exclude'.

environment.description: Per-check environment overrides. Required when mode='run' (may be empty).

reason.description: Compact prose explaining why a check is excluded. Required when mode='exclude'; absent when mode='run'.

artifacts.description: Optional list of artifacts the runner must record in the manifest.

policy.description: Closure policy fields. Every boolean field is required and must be true for closure v1.

runner_authority.description: Optional runner authority declaration for Closure Protocol v2 portable runner authority. Defines how the runner identity is bound to the closure subject.

mode.description: The runner authority mode. 'subject_exact' requires runner vcs.revision == target subject. 'tool_release_exact' requires runner vcs.revision == pinned tool revision (independent of target).

tool.description: Tool authority block. Required for tool_release_exact mode. Optional and forbidden in strict mode for subject_exact.

revision.description: Full lowercase 40-character Git OID of the Leamas source revision.

tree_oid.description: Full lowercase Git OID of the Leamas source tree.

binary_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the runner binary.
